name: Pressure Point Training
description:
You are trained in special pressure point techniques. You may spend an action to make a pressure point attack, rolling Dexterity vs Defense against an adjacent creature. On a win, choose one:

  • The creature checks a Condition.

  • The creature's speed is reduced by 5 ft.

  • The creature takes -1d to all rolls under BODY for 1 round.

  • The creature cannot use reactions for 1 round.

You may make multiple pressure point attacks each turn. The effects are cumulative.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Catch Them Off-Guard
improvements.description: In Engagement, you may spend Engagement successes to make pressure point attacks. You still must make the opposed skill check for each attack.

improvements.name: Five Touch Attack
improvements.description: If you successfully make five pressure point attacks against the same creature within one round, they roll Injury and check a Condition. Their speed is reduced to zero until the end of their next turn.
